title: Trump Rallies GOP Ahead of Midterm Elections
description:
Republicans are preparing for a first-of-its-kind midterm convention in Dallas on Sept. 9 and 10, with President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance among the featured speakers as the party seeks to mobilize voters ahead of November. Joining Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend is Co-host of Bloomberg's Balance of Power Kailey Leinz and she says that the gathering will also spotlight competitive races including the Texas Senate contest, even as some Republicans in swing districts plan to stay away and campaign at home.
